lines.trans: Max, I did stupid things today.
Do not worry, all cooks make mistakes.

words.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

lines.trans: But the chef shouted so loudly at me!
We cannot help making various mistakes.
Do you really think that this is normal?
Mistakes are an important part of our life.
And what can they teach us?
They help us find the right path.
So every blunder makes us stronger?
That is exactly how we become true masters.

words.gloss: to become, to get, to grow

lines.trans: Then I will not get so upset anymore.
The main thing is to remember one's lessons and move forward.
Thank you for the support, you are a great friend.
Tomorrow we will show top class in the kitchen!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: direction: идти вперёд = to go forward
colloquial, like a preposition + genitive: лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

meanings.en: to do (something wrong), make a mess
meanings.note: Что ты натворил? = What have you done?

examples.trans: Look at what they've done here!

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.

examples.trans: A course of the correct antibiotics.

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.
